list.title: Version Update Notes
list.header: Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms

data.html:
"At last ... after all this time ... we'll finally get to meet after crossing the 'Shroom World'".

Dear Endministrator,

Welcome to the new version, [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms]!

▼// Maintenance Update & Compensation Details

■ Update & Maintenance Time

Asia Server: Nov. 25, 2026 at 06:00 – Nov. 25, 2026 at 12:00 (UTC+8)

Americas / Europe Server: Nov. 24, 2026 at 17:00 – Nov. 24, 2026 at 23:00 (UTC-5)

※ The server reopening time after maintenance may be earlier or later than scheduled. Please check the official announcement for details.

■ Maintenance Update & Bug Fix Compensation Details

· Update & Maintenance Compensation: [Oroberyl]×900

· Bug Fix Compensation: [Oroberyl]×900

· Distribution Period: After the update and maintenance – Before the next version update and maintenance

· Eligibility: Create a character before the update

· Note: Update & Maintenance Compensation and Bug Fix Compensation will be sent in two separate in-game mails after the [Mail] feature is unlocked. The mails will expire during the next version update and maintenance, so be sure to claim the compensations in time.

■ Update Notes

This update is mandatory. After the update is complete, you will need to re-download and reinstall the game client. Once the version update and maintenance begin, you can follow the in-game instructions to proceed with the update.

· iOS: Enter the App Store and tap [Update].

· Android: Enter the game and follow the pop-up prompts to complete the update.

· PlayStation®5: Go to the home screen, select [Arknights: Endfield], press the controller's [OPTIONS] button, select [Check for Update], and confirm the update.

· PC: After closing the game, restart the GRYPHLINK launcher and click [Update].

※ After [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] version update, some content will unlock gradually over time as your exploration progresses. Please refer to the in-game version for the actual update details.

▼// New Version Content

■ New Stories

1. Exploration Mission

[Giga-Shroom Up Close]

2. Side Missions

[I Dream of Honey Waffles], [The Day After], [Rebuilding a Home I], [Rebuilding a Home II], [Rebuilding a Home III]

■ New Operators

6★ operator [Kay], 5★ operator [Mimino]

■ New Weapons

6★ weapons [Sweet Deal (Polearm)], [Raid Comet (Polearm)], 5★ weapon [Star of Tomorrow (Handcannon)]

■ New Enemies

[Shroomkrusher Nidwyrm], [Bolete Prince], [Shroomkrusher Sporeknuckles], [Shroomkrusher Sporeguard]

■ New Area

[Wuling - Old Dam]

■ New Headhunting Events and Issues

1. [Anvil, Backpack, Plus A Pot o'Honey] Chartered Headhunting

· Availability: After [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] version update – Dec. 23, 2026 at 11:59 (server time)

· Headhunting Details: [Anvil, Backpack, Plus A Pot o'Honey] Chartered Headhunting features the Rate-UP 6★ operator [Kay]. 6★ operators that may appear in [Anvil, Backpack, Plus A Pot o'Honey] Chartered Headhunting include: Kay / Argent Flow / Si / Ember / Lifeng / Ardelia / Last Rite / Pogranichnik.

· During [Anvil, Backpack, Plus A Pot o'Honey] Chartered Headhunting, [Combat Drills] will also become available for trying out the 6★ operator [Kay]. Complete the specified stage with the preset team that includes the trial operator and go to the [Event Center] screen to claim [Oroberyl]×100, [Arsenal Defense Crate], [Mark of Perseverance], and other rewards. The [Arsenal Defense Crate] contains a Fully Artificed Level 60 Gear Set that is a good fit for the current trial operator. You can also exchange for [Roaming Wilderpaw HH Permit] at a discount in [AIC Quota Exchange]. Up to [Roaming Wilderpaw HH Permit]×5 can be exchanged.

2. [Casual Roamer Issue] Arsenal Issue Open

· Availability: Opens after [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] version update; ends after 3 [Chartered Headhunting] banners (starting from the [Anvil, Backpack, Plus A Pot o'Honey] banner)

· Issue Details: [Casual Roamer Issue] Arsenal Issue features the Rate-UP 6★ weapon [Sweet Deal (Polearm)]. 6★ weapons that may appear in [Casual Roamer Issue] Arsenal Issue include: Sweet Deal (Polearm) / Fuyao (Sword) / Valiant (Polearm) / JET (Polearm) / Detonation Unit (Arts Unit) / Wedge (Handcannon) / Former Finery (Greatsword).

3. [To Every Wish Adrift] RE-Factor Headhunting #1

· Availability: After [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] version update – Dec. 16, 2026 at 11:59 (server time)

· Headhunting Details: [To Every Wish Adrift] RE-Factor #1 Headhunting features the Rate-UP 6★ operator [Gilberta]. 6★ operators that may appear in the [To Every Wish Adrift] RE-Factor Headhunting #1 include: Gilberta / Ember / Lifeng / Ardelia / Last Rite / Pogranichnik.

4. [Floaty Traveler Issue] RE-Factor Issue #1 Open

· Availability: After [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] version update – Dec. 16, 2026 at 11:59 (server time)

· Issue Details: [Floaty Traveler Issue] RE-Factor Issue #1 features the Rate-UP 6★ weapon [Delivery Guaranteed (Arts Unit)]. 6★ weapons that may appear in [Floaty Traveler Issue] RE-Factor Issue #1 include: Delivery Guaranteed (Arts Unit) / Chivalric Virtues (Arts Unit) / Oblivion (Arts Unit) / Wedge (Handcannon) / Thermite Cutter (Sword) / White Night Nova (Sword) / Exemplar (Greatsword).

5. [Precious Scarlet] RE-Factor Headhunting #1

· Availability: Dec. 16, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance

· Headhunting Details: [Precious Scarlet] RE-Factor #1 Headhunting features the Rate-UP 6★ operator [Rossi]. 6★ operators that may appear in the [Precious Scarlet] RE-Factor Headhunting #1 include: Rossi / Ember / Lifeng / Ardelia / Last Rite / Pogranichnik.

6. [Scarlet Claws Issue] RE-Factor Issue #1 Open

· Availability: Dec. 16, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance

· Issue Details: [Scarlet Claws Issue] RE-Factor Issue #1 features the Rate-UP 6★ weapon [Lupine Scarlet (Sword)]. 6★ weapons that may appear in [Scarlet Claws Issue] RE-Factor Issue #1 include: Lupine Scarlet (Sword) / Fuyao (Sword) / Eminent Repute (Sword) / Wedge (Handcannon) / Former Finery (Greatsword) / Detonation Unit (Arts Unit) / Valiant (Polearm).

■ New Events

1. [I Dream of Honey Waffles] Narrative Event

· Event Time: Throughout the [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] version

· Event Details: Complete the side mission [I Dream of Honey Waffles] to earn [Oroberyl]×600, [Elementary Cognitive Carrier], and other rewards.

※ After the narrative event page is removed, you can still play this side mission from [Mission] and earn the rewards if you meet the participation requirements.

2. [Array Building: Mend the Old Gash] Building Event

· Event Time: Throughout the [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] version

· Event Details: During the event, progress through missions to unlock the [Exclusion Zone Rebuilding] game mode and related AIC technologies, then use the AIC to produce supplies needed by the Exclusion Zone Rebuilding project, advance Rebuilding Progress, and complete Construction Tasks to earn event rewards that include: [Oroberyl] x1000, [Advanced Progression Selection Crate Ⅱ], [Mark of Perseverance], [Origo-Artificing Fluid Mk Ⅰ], and [Advanced Cognitive Carrier].

※ After the [Array Building: Mend the Old Gash] Building Event ends, you will no longer be able to complete Construction Tasks or claim the corresponding rewards. However, you can still play [Exclusion Zone Rebuilding] and claim Rebuilding Progress rewards.

3. [Roaming Wilderpaw] Sign-In Event

· Event Time: After [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] version update – Dec. 23, 2026 at 11:59 (server time)

· Event Details: Sign in for a total of 7 days to earn rewards such as [Roaming Wilderpaw HH Permit]×5.

4. [Caps! Shrooms! FUNGI!] Guide Event

· Event Time: After [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] version update – Dec. 23, 2026 at 12:00 (server time)

· Event Details: Visit the [Old Dam] area in [Wuling] and complete specified missions to claim event rewards such as [Oroberyl]×1200 and [Mark of Perseverance].

5. [Sanity Supply] Limited-Time Event

· Event Time:

Asia Server:

Dec. 9, 2026 at 04:00 – Dec. 16, 2026 at 04:00 (server time)

Dec. 31, 2026 at 04:00 – Jan. 7, 2027 at 04:00 (server time)

Americas / Europe Server:

Dec. 9, 2026 at 04:00 – Dec. 16, 2026 at 04:00 (server time)

Dec. 31, 2026 at 04:00 – Jan. 6, 2027 at 17:00 (server time)

· Event Details: During the event, complete specified missions every day to claim Sanity Supply rewards: [Sanity Usage Permit] and [Emergency Sanity Booster].

6. [RISE! MEGA ARENA!] Challenge Event

· Event Time: Dec. 16, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance

· Event Update Time: Dec. 18, 2026 at 04:00 (server time)

· Event Details: During the event, complete challenge stages to earn rewards, including [Oroberyl]×1200, [Portrait Frame: Crown-Snatcher's Bright Star], [Advanced Progression Selection Crate Ⅱ], [Mark of Perseverance], and [Advanced Cognitive Carrier].

7. [Lucky Carrot's Games of Wonder] Fun & Games Event

· Event Time: Dec. 16, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance

· Event Update Time: Dec. 23, 2026 at 04:00 (server time)

· Event Details: During the event, experience the "Witchcraft Paradise" games, complete Games Challenges to earn [Carrot Payper], and spend [Carrot Payper] at the [Souvenir Exchange] to exchange for event rewards, including [Oroberyl]×1000, [Advanced Progression Selection Crate Ⅱ], [Mark of Perseverance], and [Advanced Cognitive Carrier].

8. [Workers' Guards: Roll Call] Giveaway Event

· Event Time: Dec. 16, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance

· Event Details: During the event, log into the game and participate in various game modes to claim the new max-potential 5★ operator [Mimino] and new max-potential 5★ weapon [Star of Tomorrow (Handcannon)].

9. [Endmin! Let's Sort the Prezzies!] Fun & Games Event

· Event Time: Dec. 23, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance

· Event Details: Visit the Web Event page to sort gift boxes on transport belts, experience various stages, and claim event rewards, including [Oroberyl]×300 and [T-Creds].

■ Event & Gameplay Updates

1. [Echoes of War] Permanent Challenge Mode Update

○[Season of Scattering]

· Season Update: After [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] version update – Dec. 16, 2026 at 11:59 (server time)

· Update Notes: New season [Season of Scattering] is available. This season features 3 cycles, each including 3 stages. [Season of Scattering] adds 3 new stages. Clear all new stages on Normal difficulty to claim rewards including [Oroberyl]×300.

○[Season of Wariness]

· Season Update: Dec. 16, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance

· Update Notes: New season [Season of Wariness] is available. This season features 3 cycles, each including 3 stages. [Season of Wariness] adds 3 new stages. Clear all new stages on Normal difficulty to claim rewards including [Oroberyl]×300.

2. [Umbral Monument] Challenge Gameplay Updated, [Despot Weaponized] Special Series Stages Available

· Availability: Dec. 2, 2026 at 12:00 (server time)

· Update Notes: This [Umbral Monument] challenge mode update will introduce a new special series, [Despot Weaponized], where you will fight powerful enemy bosses. 1 stage will be available initially, and the second stage will become available after Dec. 9, 2026 at 04:00 (server time). Each stage has multiple difficulty levels. Complete all difficulty levels of all stages to earn rewards that include: [Mark of Perseverance], [Advanced Progression Selection Crate Ⅱ], and [Advanced Cognitive Carrier].

[Monumental Revelation: Tyranny] limited-time challenge event will also be available once the gameplay mode is updated.

· Event Time: Dec. 2, 2026 at 12:00 – Dec. 23, 2026 at 04:00 (server time)

· Event Update Time: Dec. 9, 2026 at 04:00 (server time)

· Event Details: After the release of the [Despot Weaponized] series, the [Monumental Revelation: Tyranny] limited-time event will begin. During the event, complete various [Umbral Monument] challenges to claim event rewards, including [Oroberyl]×1200 and [Advanced Progression Selection Crate Ⅱ].

3. [Delver of the Cryptic Special Edition] Spatial Set Update

· Update Time: Dec. 27, 2026 at 12:00 (server time)

· Update Notes: This [Delver of the Cryptic Special Edition] puzzle-solving event will introduce the new spatial set [Esoteric Mycology]. 3 new Protocol Spaces will be available. Complete the spatial set challenges to claim rewards, including [Oroberyl]×600 and [Mark of Perseverance].

■ Acquisition Center Update

· [Protocol Pass: Shroom World] is available. During the [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] version period, you can acquire various support items listed by the Arsenal Engineers in the [Protocol Pass]. Activating each seasonal Protocol Pass unlocks the [Basic Supply] tier by default. Level up the Pass to earn rewards such as [Basic HH Permit], [Oroberyls], [Exchange Crate-o-Surprise], and [Progression Materials].

· Added in [Acquisition Center: Bundles]: [Wild Roamer HH Bundle], [Protocol Flow Bundle]. The purchase limit for [Value Arsenal Ticket Pack] is reset.

■ AIC Factory

· Added [Wuling Multi-Line Engraving Kit]. Use it to obtain an essence with three custom attributes. After the [Wuling – Yinglung Pass] Stock Redistribution Terminal reaches level 4, you can use [Wuling Stock Bill] to purchase [Wuling Multi-Line Engraving Kit] ×1.

· The Regional Development Level cap for the [Wuling] region is increased. Sub-PAC can now be deployed in [Wuling - Old Dam]. Added new exchangeable goods to [Wuling Stock Redistribution].

· Added array-related AIC Mode to Wuling AIC, along with array-related AIC Plans: [Forge Ignition], [Rebuilding Supply], [Expansion: Turbid], [L/T Equilibrium], [L/T Stacking], [Forge Bipolarity], [Forge Expansion V]. Also added the corresponding AIC facilities, simulations, and system blueprints.

· Added the [Exclusion Zone Rebuilding] game mode: Unlocked after completing the mission [Rebuilding a Home II]. Use the AIC Factory to produce rebuilding supplies and deliver them to the [Rebuilding Supply Port] to advance the [Exclusion Zone] Rebuilding Phase and increase [Wuling]'s regional development.

■ System

· Added the [Waffle Piloting] gameplay: Endministrators can launch and control honey waffles in the [Wuling - Old Dam] area. While flying, a waffle can gather Aurylenes. Dipping honey waffles in different types of spores gives them different effects. For example, dipping a waffle in chilly spores lets it reveal and dispel Delulu Walls. Additionally, a new [Invert Y-Axis Controls] option has been added to [Settings - Controller].

· [Talosite Exchange] exchangeable items updated, with new [Gear Template], [Personal Device], [Ornamental], [Camera Pose], [Vinyl], and more.

■ Others

· Added content such as [Operator Guide], [Energy Alluvium], [NPC], [Engraved Medal], [Profile Theme], [Portrait], [Portrait Frame], [Filter], [Sticker], [Consumable], [Material], [Sanity Meds], [Database Entry], [Clue Dossier], [Personal Device], [Ornamental], [Vinyl], [Camera Pose], [Regional Aurylene Submission Phase], and more. These will gradually unlock as you progress.

· Added new gear pieces to Gear Sets [Rift Trekker], [Frontiers], [Eternal Xiranite] and [AIC Fieldwork].

· Added a new rare progression material [Origo-Artificing Fluid Mk Ⅰ].

※ Please check in-game for more details.

▼// Optimizations & Adjustments

■ Combat

· Improved the visual effects of the enemy [Nefarith] in certain situations.

■ AIC Factory

· Improved the placement of [Item Control Ports] and [Pipe Control Ports]. They can now be placed without first being connected to a transport belt or pipe. They can connect directly to the belt or pipe ports of a facility and will automatically snap into place in the correct orientation.

■ System

· Improved the upgrade prompts on the [Operators - Ability Matrix] screen. When an upgrade requires many types of materials, materials in insufficient quantities are automatically repositioned and displayed first.

■ Others

· Improved the visuals, special effects, interaction logic, and text descriptions for certain interfaces.

· Improved the models, clothing, special effects, movements, camera work, and other presentation aspects of certain operators in certain situations.

· Improved some text related to orders and dishes in Innkeeping mode.

· Optimized the text descriptions for some Operator Guides.

· Optimized some Operator Files text.

· Optimized some control-related UI prompts.

· Optimized some mission names.

· Optimized some story text.

· Improved the event type names and text descriptions for some events and activities based on how they work in-game.

· Refined the names and descriptions of some items based on how they work in-game.

· Optimized some tutorial text.

▼// Bug Fixes

■ Missions

· Fixed an issue in the side mission [A Snowy Realm Touched by Nightmares] where the Endministrator's combo skill could fail to deal damage normally when hitting enemies who have [shield stacks].

■ Combat

· Fixed a circumstantial issue where operators' ultimate could be abnormally interrupted.

· Fixed a circumstantial issue where 6★ operator [Si]'s [Inksoul] could behave abnormally after being hit with a finisher.

· Fixed an issue where certain inputs could cause the [Final Stroke] of 6★ operator [Si]'s battle skill to deal damage abnormally.

· Fixed an issue where 6★ operator [Si]'s combo skill failed to trigger when 5★ operator [Alesh]'s battle skill solidified and defeated the enemy.

· Fixed an issue where, when 6★ operator [Typhoeus]'s combo skill was cast repeatedly using certain control inputs, the Barrage Arrays from later castings failed to increase the Nature Burst DMG taken by enemies.

· Fixed a circumstantial issue where 6★ operator [Typhoeus]'s Hovering state could become abnormal after she cast her battle skill.

■ Events & Gameplay

· Fixed a circumstantial issue where, in the [Beast File: Qingbo Stockade] stage of the permanent challenge mode [Echoes of War], 6★ operator [Arcane]'s combo skill could fail to trigger when [Array Arcana: INT] skill type was active.

· Fixed a circumstantial issue where, in the [Marked by Dark Shadows - Sudden Roar of Oblivion] stage of the permanent game mode [Umbral Monument], the damage values recorded by 6★ operator [Si]'s [Artful Intent] could be abnormal.

■ System

· Fixed a circumstantial issue where, after pressing the [Create and save 1 blueprint] mission in [Operational Manual - Node 03] and being redirected to map, the map could appear abnormal.

■ Others

· Fixed an issue where certain inputs caused 6★ operator [Si]'s status icon to be displayed abnormally.

list.title: Risk Warning
list.header: Security Risk Warning for Using Unofficial Tools

data.html:
Authorizing account login on third-party websites or tools carries security risks, such as the leakage of account information or misuse of data. To ensure your account security, we remind all players to note the following:

1. Do not authorize account login on any third-party platforms from unknown sources or lacking official certification.

2. Avoid entering account information or completing authorization on unofficial pages, as this may lead to risks such as information leakage or abnormal login activity.

3. Be sure to log in to the game and related service pages only through official channels, and exercise caution to avoid clicking links from unknown sources.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. Let's work together to maintain a safe and orderly gaming environment.

list.title: Account Security Reminder
list.header: Gryphline Account Security Device Verification Is Now Live

data.html:
Dear Endministrator,

To further enhance the security of your Gryphline Account and safeguard your account and game assets, a [Security Device Verification] feature has been added to the account system.
Players can enable [New Device Login Verification] in the Account Center. Once enabled:
- The system will display a list of devices previously used to log in to the account;
- You can manage your logged-in devices and remove any device;
- When logging in on a removed or a new device, you must enter a verification code sent to your linked email to complete identity verification before you can successfully log in.

How to enable:
PC: Settings → Account Center → Security Settings → Manage Device
Mobile: Settings → Account Center → Manage Game → Manage Device

We recommend all players enable this feature as soon as possible to enhance account security.
Please safeguard your account information. Do not log in through unofficial channels or share your password on any third-party platform (including top-up, power-leveling, or account trading services) to avoid security risks.
Thank you for your understanding and support.

Thank you for your continued interest and support for Arknights: Endfield. To maintain a healthy and fair gaming environment and protect the legitimate rights and interests of all players, we would like to remind everyone of the following:

1. The use of cheats, third-party tools, unauthorized top-ups, or any other improper methods that disrupt the game's integrity or violate the Game Terms of Service is strictly prohibited. Based on backend monitoring and player reports, if such violations are confirmed, we will take appropriate action depending on the severity of the offense, including but not limited to the removal of illicit gains, temporary suspension, or permanent account bans.

2. To protect the legitimate rights and interests of all players, please do not transfer, share, or trade your game account. Any consequences resulting from such actions, including account theft or loss of in-game assets, shall be borne by the player.

3. To ensure a complete gameplay experience, players are strictly prohibited from unpacking, modifying, or tampering with the game installation files, as well as distributing related extracted materials.

Finally, creating a positive and fair gaming environment requires the collective efforts of all players. We kindly ask everyone to help maintain a fair and orderly gaming environment. If you come across any violations, please feel free to report them through our official customer service center.

list.title: Feature Usage Policy
list.header: Automated Industry Complex & Blueprint Usage Policy

data.html:
To ensure a friendly gaming environment, please follow our Terms of Service when using features related to the Automated Industry Complex. Please do not post or engage in content that involves:

1. Discrimination based on region, race, sexual orientation, religion, politics, etc.

2. Defamation, offense, or infringement of others' rights

3. Obscenity, violence, gambling, or hate

4. Anything prohibited or deemed inappropriate by the Terms of Service

If you engage in any of the above violations, penalties may be applied, including removal of items placed in the Automated Industry Complex, restrictions on AIC Factory features, and account suspension. To report violations, use the [Report] button or contact customer support.

If you use the [Share Blueprint] feature, you will get a [Blueprint Code] that lets other Endministrators view and use your [Blueprint]. Before getting started, please note: by sharing your [Blueprint Code], you're allowing anyone to view, copy, or use your design. Please consider carefully before sharing.
